title: Lou recast — Ash — line 14
direction: Lou is a middle-aged American gas station manager, an ex-crook who has settled into ordinary work. His voice has a light natural rasp and a rough working-class edge, but his manner is relaxed, warm and dryly amused. Speak plainly to Johnny, a coworker standing nearby. Easy everyday rhythm, clear words, small natural pauses. The texture is in the voice, not in exaggerated growling. Play the conversation casually and sincerely. A short, mildly surprised question.
